decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the firm's established machining offer and fits its announced push toward smarter automation, so the commitment is visible and strategically central, and with only one year on the market any weak results can still be read as temporary.

The dual-table loader builds on the core machine business and supports the firm's public automation direction, and it cost little to keep as an accessory option, so the firm has no reason to write it off after its first year.

Although the dispensing machine is distant from the core offer, the firm committed to it publicly with its own web page and celebrated its Red Dot Design Award, and the heavy development investment makes dropping it now very unlikely.
